item.title: DFIR 101
item.description: DFIR 101 is a course that focuses on the principles and practices of digital forensics and incident response. It covers the fundamentals of collecting, preserving, and analyzing digital evidence.

item.title: OSINT 101 Project
item.description: OSINT101 is a course that focuses on the use of tools and techniques for research and analysis of information. It covers the basics of OSINT and demonstrates various methods that can be used for research and information gathering.
